inline_comments.comment: `# creates: cu.png` is a legacy comment from the old ASE gallery build system (which used it to track generated artifacts). It has no special meaning to sphinx-gallery and will appear verbatim in the rendered code block on the gallery page. Remove it.

`filename='cu.png'` is carried over from the legacy gallery pattern. In the current implementation, `finish_plot()` calls `self.ax.figure.savefig(filename)` but does not close the figure, so sphinx-gallery can still capture the open figure for its thumbnail — this part is fine. However, it does write a `cu.png` artifact to `examples/gallery/` on every doc build. Per project rules, gallery-generated output files must be removed by `make clean`; verify this artifact is covered. The idiomatic sphinx-gallery approach is to omit `filename=` entirely and rely on sphinx-gallery's automatic figure capture, which avoids the artifact entirely.

The docstring contains only a title with no descriptive text. Per sphinx-gallery conventions and project tutorial standards, at least a sentence of prose should follow the title — e.g., 'Plots the free-electron band structure for FCC copper along the GXWLGK path using the `FreeElectrons` test calculator.' This text renders as introductory prose on the gallery page.

general_comments.comment: The migration is incomplete. The PR description says it is *moving* the example, but `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` (the old source file) is not deleted, and `doc/gallery/gallery.rst` lines 43–50 still reference it (`.. image:: ../ase/dft/cu.png` and `:download:`bs.py <../ase/dft/bs.py>``). After this PR, both the old and new versions co-exist. The old `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` should be deleted and the Band-structure section in `doc/gallery/gallery.rst` should be removed or updated to point to the new sphinx-gallery-generated page.

The `examples/gallery/` subdirectory has no `README.rst` or `GALLERY_HEADER.rst`. Sphinx-gallery requires every sub-gallery directory to contain a header file with a valid RST section title in order to process the directory and generate the sub-gallery index. Without it, the gallery build either fails or produces a blank/untitled section. A minimal `README.rst` with at least a section heading (e.g., `Gallery\n=======`) must be added. This appears to be a pre-existing gap (since `ptable.py` is already there without one), but the migration work is a natural opportunity to fix it.

No `changelog.d/` fragment is included. Per project conventions, user-visible changes — including new sphinx-gallery examples — require a scriv fragment (`scriv create`) placed in `changelog.d/`. The entry should reference the relevant module (`:mod:`ase.spectrum.band_structure``) and the MR number.
